content: {"episode_id":"ep-05093","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
